subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The museum learned that digital guides should not pull attention away from the real thing.”?
options: A good cover cannot make a bad book good, but a missing cover can hide a good book from busy eyes.
In a world full of advice, students learned that health decisions should not be made by the loudest voice on a screen.
Good technology should lead eyes back to the world, not trap them on a screen.
Technology can support good habits, but it should not become an excuse to stop looking, smelling, planning, and thinking.
